dimensions.assessment: Affects Accountable Care Organizations, Medicare participants, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.
dimensions.evidence: enables ACOs to receive payments for savings stemming from care coordination and management

dimensions.assessment: Provides reporting flexibility and test programs for digital quality measures, altering administrative compliance rules for participating ACOs.
dimensions.evidence: allows ACOs to continue to use prior methods of reporting quality measures through 2029

dimensions.assessment: Appropriates $8,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 for implementation and reduces the Medicare Improvement Fund from $2,062,000,000 to $2,054,000,000.
dimensions.evidence: There are appropriated... $8,000,000 for fiscal year 2026... to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Program Management Account

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Social Security Act to adjust reporting timelines, data completeness rules, and establish a multi-year pilot program.
dimensions.evidence: establish a digital quality measure reporting pilot program... for each of performance years 2028 through 2032

dimensions.assessment: Governs reporting rules and pilot programs spanning performance years through 2032.
dimensions.evidence: for performance years 2025 through 2029... digital quality measure reporting pilot program... for each of performance years 2028 through 2032

missing_information: Long-term fiscal savings or exact administrative burdens saved by individual ACOs.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill delays quality measure reporting requirements for Accountable Care Organizations under Medicare through 2029, creates a digital reporting pilot program from 2028 to 2032, appropriates $8 million for implementation, and reduces the Medicare Improvement Fund by an equal amount.
